audit.whatIsWrong: Devour and Abyssal Dive letters are swapped/wrong in several content fields: spikes[1].text tags Devour as '(R/W)', spikes[2].text calls Abyssal Dive 'W (Devour)', wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1] both call Devour '(W)' and/or Abyssal Dive '(R)'.
audit.why: enemyKit is authoritative: W = Abyssal Dive (knockup dive/escape), R = Devour (eat a champion). The text elsewhere correctly treats Devour as an eat/save tool and Abyssal Dive as the dive engage/escape, so only the slot letters were wrong.
audit.corrected: Fixed the (W)/(R) letters on Devour and Abyssal Dive in spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, wants.you[2], and wants.foe[1].

audit.why: EVEN/Skill framing across all 7 phases is grounded and matches win[0-6]=Skill throughout; both sides trade single-target CC with no clean spike either way, which lines up with the near-even 47.8% winrate.

Spikes correctly flag level 2 (dueling three-stack Tongue Lash stun vs Cosmic Binding), level 6 (Devour vs Tempered Fate, different jobs), first item (tank scaling vs continued poke), late (execution-decided skill lane).

edits.before: Tahm's Devour (R/W) lets him save his ADC by eating them or reposition to gank, but it doesn't out-damage your all-in; your Tempered Fate (R) and stun can lock him before he Devours, though he can W away from your engage. Even trade of ults with different jobs.
edits.after: Tahm's Devour (R) lets him save his ADC by eating them, or he can dive away using Abyssal Dive (W) instead; it doesn't out-damage your all-in, and your Tempered Fate (R) can lock him before he Devours. Even trade of ults with different jobs.

edits.before: Tahm's first item pads his tanky peel and he can shrug off poke, but your Meeps autos and Q picks keep the pressure even; play around when his W (Devour) and Q are on cooldown.
edits.after: Tahm's first item pads his tanky peel and he can shrug off poke, but your Meeps autos and Q picks keep the pressure even; play around when his Abyssal Dive (W) and Q are down.

edits.before: Hold R to lock him before he can Devour (W) his ADC to safety
edits.after: Hold R to lock him before he can Devour (R) his ADC to safety

edits.before: Use Devour (W) to save his ADC or Abyssal Dive (R) to reposition
edits.after: Use Devour (R) to save his ADC or Abyssal Dive (W) to reposition

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Drop W (Health shrine) before he engages — it only heals once shielded, so pre-place it and buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: R-ing your own carry into a Devour-ready Tahm hands him the free eat — check before you cast.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - E Magical Journey is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive is 21/20/19/18/17s — his re-engage and his escape, all-in only while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - E Magical Journey is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

notes: Recurring ability-slot bug found: enemyKit confirms W=Abyssal Dive (knockup dive/escape), R=Devour (eat a champion), but several content fields swapped or mistagged the letters (spikes[1] tagged Devour '(R/W)', spikes[2] called Abyssal Dive 'W (Devour)', wants.you[2]/wants.foe[1] both had Devour and Abyssal Dive's letters backwards).
